title: AdvancedLogg
description: Tired of the griefers destroying your buildings? Can't resolve the dispute about "who took my diamonds from the chest"? - AdvancedLogg is suitable for you!
body:
**Advanced Logging is your final answer. This plugin is not just another logger; it is a powerful but easy-to-use tool for administrators that meticulously records every significant action on your server and allows you to instantly find the information you need right in the game.**

**Why do you need AdvancedLogg?**

Instead of spending hours browsing text files, you get complete control and confidence. With Advanced Log, you can:
Instantly find griefers: Track down exactly who broke blocks or stole items anywhere in the world, down to the second.
Resolve disputes with facts: Provide players with irrefutable evidence of who, when, and what items were placed or taken from any container.
Fully monitor the server: Get a complete picture of the activity on the server — from using commands to opening doors, even when you are not online.
Save time and nerves: Forget about manual log search. Get beautifully formatted reports in seconds using simple game commands with smart auto-completion.

**Key functions:**

Detailed logging of containers: Records the opening and closing of chests, furnaces, barrels, shallocks, funnels and all other storage units.
Tracking the movement of objects: Records each item (ITEM\PUT, ITEM\_TAKE) that was placed or taken from the container, indicating the quantity and type. No more mysterious resource disappearances!
Logging of the world: Tracks every broken (BLOCK\BREAK) and installed (BLOCK\_PLACE) block.
Full control over the players: Logs input/output (PLAYER\JOIN/PLAYER\_QUIT) and each command (COMMAND\_EXECUTE) used by the player.

**Powerful in-game search:**

/alogg <coordinates> — check the history of a specific block.
/alogg player <player> — view all the actions of a particular player.
/alogg recent — keep up to date with the latest developments on the server.

**Flexible setup:** You decide what to log. Each function can be enabled or disabled in a simple and intuitive config.yml file.

**Automatic cleaning:** The plugin deletes old logs on its own so as not to take up extra disk space. Set up how long to keep the history.

**Multilingual:** Ready-made translations for Russian, English and Chinese.
